title: Rust Beginner Mock Test 3
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Rust at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about Cargo is valid?

options.text: Cargo.lock policy differs between applications and libraries
Cargo builds tests and manages crate metadata
use cargo check test and run as separate evidence
The compiler silently repairs the design

questions.explanation: Cargo.lock policy differs between applications and libraries. Confirm with cargo check, Clippy, and a focused test.
